content.short: Pocket Towne is launching with a CNFT sale of our genesis paper dolls! These dolls will be your avatar for the world of Pocket Towne.
content.description:
Pocket Towne is a place. A place we want to bring to life... a place that we have already imagined. A hidden gem in a desert oasis.

Pocketers can create their own little getaway while gaming and socializing. We want to build a platform that gives artists another way to present their work, as well as a game that actively works to integrate other CNFT projects.

Excited yet? If not, you should be!
